text:
Maya: Basil the parakeet just discovered the neighbor's cat through the living room window. He did a full theatrical faint and then staged a comeback. photo: https://redwood-internal.s3.amazonaws.com/uploads/basil_window.jpg :squawk:

Raj: OMG he looks like a tiny angry feather mop. :laughing: dropping my coffee from across the room.

Sophie: 10/10 dramatic timing. also that tilt of the head kills me. can I borrow him for standup material? :joy:

Tom: I swear birds have the best facial expressions. Also the cat in the background is like `nope` 😂

Olivia: Caption contest: "When you realize the snack cabinet is on the other side of the glass." Winner gets an overpriced plant. :seedling:

Maya: I vote "Traitor of the Seed Bowl". (also @Sophie I will absolutely send a cameo for your set)

Raj: Also PSA: Basil sits on my laptop charger sometimes and it now has tiny peck marks. Tech ops, what are our repair policies for bird-nibbled cables? :thinking_face:

Tom: Submit a ticket to #help with photo evidence and a dramatic caption. Attachments help. :hammer_and_wrench:

Sophie: giphy-bot: bird dramatic faint 

giphy-bot: :giphy: https://giphy.com/gifs/drama-parrot-3oEjI6SIIHBdRxXI40

Olivia: Basil update: he is now on the bookshelf giving the cat a spreadsheet-level side-eye. I will deliver more evidence later. :mag: :eye:
